generatedCommentsNodes.comment: The optimizer rule only checks if the left side of the comparison is a `ChangeCase` function (`bc.left() instanceof ChangeCase`). Since equality and inequality operators are commutative, this optimization should also be applied when the `ChangeCase` function is on the right side (e.g., `WHERE "FOO" == TO_UPPER(first_name)`). Currently, such queries will not be optimized or pushed down.

review_comment: As an alternative to avoid the pattern matching, use `Strings.deleteAny(input, " ")` or `Strings.replace(input, " ", "")`
The `\s` class will match more (`[ \t\n\x0B\f\r]`). I use it to compare (multiline, "randomly" spaced) JSONs.
